findings.fix: State the lemma on `Set.uIcc a b` with no `hab`, e.g. `ContinuousOn γ (Set.uIcc a b) → (∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, γ t ≠ w) → ∃ ρ > 0, ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ρ ≤ ‖γ t - w‖`, and derive the `Icc` uses by rewriting under `a ≤ b`.
findings.issue: `exists_curve_dist_lower_bound` is public but specialized to the forward interval with an extra `hab : a ≤ b`, while nearby public contour APIs use arbitrary oriented intervals via `Set.uIcc`.

summary: The main continuity theorem is stated at the natural winding-number API level, but the new public distance lemma is unnecessarily one-oriented. Generalize that support API before exposing it.
